verdict.rationale: Meltano can be fully self-hosted ('You host and manage everything on your own servers', 'Own every part of your data infrastructure, on your own servers'), so pipeline data never has to reach the vendor and cannot be used by it for training. However, there is also a vendor-hosted option ('Meltano hosts, scales, and maintains everything for you'), and the pack contains no AI-training policy, opt-out control, or data-use commitment for it. missing for 10: an explicit no-AI-training policy or opt-out setting, a data-use commitment for the hosted offering, and independent corroboration of the privacy posture.
